Class KeyEventState

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tui.event.KeyEventState
public final class KeyEventState extends Object
Represents keyboard lock and keypad state associated with a key event.

Distinguishes lock keys (Caps Lock, Num Lock) and keypad keys from standard keyboard navigation and typing.
